notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
Greetings Survivors!

After weathering Covid and other troubles along the way, the new patch is here! What is included?

Improved Graphics
Improved Models
Improved Performance
Improved Gameplay
More Items
More Skill
More Stuff!

This is the first in a series of patches as we march to full release later this year. Enjoy!

notes.title: Primitive Survival 0.3 is released!
notes.content:
Hello Primitive Survivalists!

Update 0.3 is here!

A Bigger Land:

The new terrain is 5 times the size of the previous build.

New Skills:
 
Basket Weaving will give you a place to store your stuff!

Language will allow you to communicate with others!

The first part of the tribal update is here with the addition of computer controlled tribes. You can learn the language skill by talking to members of the tribe. More functionality coming in the next patch.

Campfires now require wood or sticks to light.

Various bug fixes and optimizations for a smoother playing experience.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Primitive Survival 0.2 is released
notes.content:
Hello Primitive Survivalists!

The first update is now live and includes a number of new systems as well as some much needed optimization.

Skills:
Skills have been reworked. There are currently seven skills with more on the way.

Skill include:
Gathering which will help you find food and resources.
Hunting will help you find animals.
You can now plant your own crops which will help you survive.
Tools can be crafted.
Buildings can be built.
Clothing can be crafted.
And fire will help you see your camp at night with additional functionality coming in the next patch.

Water has been added to the game.
Swimming is a very rough work in progress. Swim at your own risk.

Combat has been reworked.

Load times have been cut down to a few seconds and graphics have been optimized for better performance.

More updates are on the way. The next update should include the first pass at the tribal system which is really the meat of the game.
